notes:
Summary: Mid-market retail personalization startup. POC for product-ranking and customer support chat. Heavy security gating from CISO/procurement.

Key CRM snippets (shorthand, from AE/SE notes):
- 2025-11-18 demo (Maya/Diego): walked through Dedicated + Private offering; showed HSM/KMS and audit log views.
- CISO asked for SOC2 Type II report + ISO27001 cert + sample penetration test report. Requested evidence of SOC2 via third-party attestation (pdf) and scope (does it cover data processing for model inference?).
- 2025-12-02: procurement reply: "We cannot accept vendor-provided audit artifacts unless accompanied by our vendor NDA and offline review at the corporate risk office."
- 2026-01-09 security call (Elena present): Valora security policy forbids circulating third-party audit artifacts outside legal perimeter; they requested Redwood to sign a vendor-specific MSA & allow on-prem verification.
- Valora insisted on an on-prem deployment or we provide signed attestations that can be stored in their internal vault. They would not accept copies of SOC2 reports via Drive/email.
- CompetitorX offered an on-prem appliance and provided SOC2 attestation under an approved procurement flow; procurement chose CompetitorX.
- Final: procurement implemented a hiring freeze / budget re-prioritization after Q4 reorg; internal champion left the company.

Quoted from CISO: "Our vendor policy prevents distribution of audit PDFs to external vendors — we need in-house verification or an on-prem option."
timeline: 2025-08-12 - Lead created after inbound form: use-case = personalization & chat
2025-09-09 - Intro call (AE Maya) - initial scope & cost sensitivity noted
2025-10-05 - Tech deep-dive with SE (Diego) - acceptable latency <120ms p95 for chat
2025-11-18 - Demo of Dedicated + Private (FF demo id attached)
2025-12-02 - Procurement requested SOC2/ISO artifacts and sample pen-test
2026-01-09 - Security review call; Valora refuses to share audit evidence externally; requests on-prem or vaulted attestation
2026-02-10 - CompetitorX confirmed as selected vendor (on-prem + attestations), procurement freeze afterwards
2026-02-20 - AE updated CRM: move to closed-lost; reason = security review failure / unwilling to share evidence
use_case_summary: Serving real-time chat for agent escalation and embeddings-backed product search; reranking for personalization. Needs p95 latency <120ms, 10k concurrent session throughput, deterministic fallbacks.
requirements_summary:
Must support VPC or on-prem, KMS-managed keys (customer-controlled), SOC2 Type II + ISO27001 evidence requested by procurement, strict audit log retention and per-route tracing. Data residency: US-only for PII.
POC asked to run with sample traffic and show end-to-end audit logs and KMS key rotation proof.
lost_reason: Security review failed: Valora's procurement/security policy disallows sharing third-party audit PDFs and requires on-prem verification or vendor attestations in their internal vault. Competitor provided on-prem + required attestations; Valora selected competitor and instituted budget freeze post-reorg. No internal champion remaining.
